database_top_statements.query: update till_reservation set state = $1, version = version + $4 where id = $2 and version = $3

select r.id, r.idem_key, r.state, r.created_at, r.expires_at, r.version from till_reservation r where r.state = $5 and r.expires_at <= $1 and r.id <> coalesce($2, $6) and exists (select $7 from till_reservation_line l where l.reservation_id
insert into till_reservation_line (reservation_id, sku, quantity) values ($1, $2, $3)
update till_stock set on_hand = $1, reserved = $2, version = version + $5, updated_at = now() where sku = $3 and version = $4
insert into till_reservation (id, idem_key, state, created_at, expires_at, version) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) on conflict (id) do nothing
insert into till_outbox (dedupe_key, payload, recorded_at) values ($1, $2, $3) on conflict (dedupe_key) do nothing
select id, customer, idem_key, reservation_id, status, total_cents, currency, created_at, expires_at, closed_at from store_order where customer = $1 and idem_key = $2

select g.sku, g.title, g.studio, g.genre, g.price_cents, g.list_price_cents, g.released_on, g.cover, g.blurb, g.description, g.features, g.tags, g.featured_rank, count(*) over () as total, ts_rank_cd(g.search, websearch_to_tsquery($7, $1))
select sku, on_hand, reserved, version from till_stock where sku = any($1) order by sku collate "C"
select g.sku, g.title, g.studio, g.genre, g.price_cents, g.list_price_cents, g.released_on, g.cover, g.blurb, g.description, g.features, g.tags, g.featured_rank from store_game g where g.sku = $1
insert into till_idempotency (idem_key, fingerprint, outcome, recorded_at) values ($1, $2, $3, $4) on conflict (idem_key) do nothing
SET SESSION CHARACTERISTICS AS TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

select t.tag as value, count(*) as count from store_game g cross join lateral unnest(g.tags) as t(tag) where $3 and (g.search @@ websearch_to_tsquery($4, $1) or g.title ilike $2 escape $5) group by t.tag order by count(*) desc, t.tag
